subject: pharmacology
title: Statins and Partners: Atorvastatin, Rosuvastatin, Ezetimibe and Fibrates

steps.tx: Competitive inhibition of **HMG CoA reductase**, the rate limiting enzyme converting HMG CoA to mevalonate in hepatic cholesterol synthesis, is the shared first move of every statin. Starved of internal cholesterol, the hepatocyte displays more LDL (low density lipoprotein) receptors, blood LDL cholesterol falls by 30 to over 50 percent depending on intensity, and plaque biology calms. Evening dosing suited short half life founders; modern long acting agents forgive any hour.
steps.say: Block the liver's cholesterol factory and it hangs out more LDL receptors; that is the whole statin trick.

vis.caption: The cholesterol synthesis pathway with HMG CoA reductase, the enzyme every statin competitively inhibits.

steps.tx: **Atorvastatin** offers high intensity lowering at 40 to 80 mg with active metabolites extending its effect across the day, making it the post acute coronary syndrome default in most protocols. **Rosuvastatin** is the most potent milligram for milligram, hydrophilic and renally handled in part, with dose ceilings in severe kidney impairment and in patients of Asian ancestry where exposure runs higher. Both are CYP3A4 neighbours to respect: atorvastatin directly, rosuvastatin mainly through transporters.
steps.say: Atorvastatin is the post infarct default; rosuvastatin is strongest per milligram with kidney and ancestry dose ceilings.

steps.tx: Muscle complaints span a ladder from common benign myalgia to **myopathy** with creatine kinase rises, and at the cliff edge, rhabdomyolysis with myoglobinuric kidney failure, rare at roughly one in a hundred thousand patient years. Risk climbs with high doses, kidney or liver disease, hypothyroidism, vitamin D deficiency and interacting drugs that raise statin levels. Most muscle pain on statins in blinded rechallenge proves unrelated, yet the ladder must be climbed respectfully every time.
steps.say: Muscle pain is common and usually innocent; weakness with dark urine is the emergency end of the ladder.

steps.tx: The interaction that writes examination questions pairs statins with CYP3A4 inhibitors: clarithromycin, azole antifungals and protease inhibitors can multiply simvastatin and atorvastatin levels into the rhabdomyolysis zone, while **gemfibrozil** blocks statin glucuronidation and uptake transporters with the same endpoint. Fenofibrate lacks that interaction and is the fibrate permitted beside a statin. Grapefruit juice in quantity joins the inhibitor list from the diet side.
steps.say: Clarithromycin or gemfibrozil on top of a statin is how rhabdomyolysis case reports begin; fenofibrate is the safe fibrate.

points: Gemfibrozil via transporter and glucuronidation blockade

steps.tx: Blocking the NPC1L1 cholesterol transporter in the jejunal brush border, **ezetimibe** stops dietary and biliary cholesterol entering the body, lowering LDL by about 18 percent alone and adding a similar slice on top of a statin. The IMPROVE IT trial converted that arithmetic into modest outcome benefit after acute coronary syndromes. It causes no muscle toxicity of its own, which makes it the polite first partner when a statin alone misses target or tolerance caps the dose.
steps.say: Ezetimibe locks the gut door cholesterol uses; eighteen percent alone, and more stacked on a statin.

nodes.label: NPC1L1 transporter blocked in jejunal brush border
Dietary and biliary cholesterol absorption falls
Liver cholesterol delivery drops, LDL receptors rise

steps.tx: Fibrates activate the nuclear receptor PPAR alpha, switching on lipoprotein lipase and fatty acid oxidation genes so triglycerides fall by up to half while HDL (high density lipoprotein) rises modestly. **Fenofibrate** suits diabetic dyslipidaemia and severe hypertriglyceridaemia threatening pancreatitis; **gemfibrozil** shares the class effect but owns the statin interaction. Fibrates also raise creatinine reversibly, displace warfarin from albumin, and increase cholesterol excretion into bile, nudging gallstone risk upward over years.
steps.say: Fibrates are triglyceride drugs through PPAR alpha; fenofibrate partners statins, gemfibrozil must not.

left.title: Fenofibrate
points: Triglycerides down up to 50 percent, HDL up modestly
Reversible creatinine rise confuses kidney charts
Diabetic retinopathy progression slowed in trials

right.title: Gemfibrozil
points: Warfarin effect potentiated by albumin displacement

steps.tx: **Statin intolerance**, real or perceived, follows a discipline before the label sticks: exclude hypothyroidism and vitamin D deficiency, check interacting drugs, dechallenge until symptoms settle, then rechallenge the same or a different statin at lower or alternate day dosing exploiting long half lives. Most patients tolerate some regimen, and the truly intolerant graduate to ezetimibe, bempedoic acid and PCSK9 therapy from the next lesson. Documenting the exact drug, dose and symptom protects future prescribers from repeating the experiment blindly.
steps.say: Dechallenge, fix the mimics, rechallenge cleverly; most statin intolerance dissolves under that discipline.

nodes.label: Muscle symptoms reported on a statin
Exclude thyroid, vitamin D and interaction causes
Alternate day, different statin, or non statin pathway

steps.tx: Beyond LDL, statins carry **pleiotropic** claims: improved endothelial function, plaque stabilisation, anti inflammatory and antithrombotic signals that track with high sensitivity CRP falls in trials. Whether these add beyond LDL lowering itself remains debated, but the clinical translation is settled: intensity follows absolute cardiovascular risk, therapy is lifelong after events, and stopping for minor enzyme ripples forfeits protection. Liver failure from statins is vanishingly rare; routine enzyme monitoring beyond baseline faded from guidelines.
steps.say: Whatever the pleiotropy debate, intensity follows risk and the prescription is for life after an event.
